claim.value: The other sampled orders should be used to test whether the candidate routes also explain apparently complete records.
claim.scope: Orders outside the 14 flagged cases, within the existing sample; apparent completeness is not established compliance.

provenance.rationale: P008 supplies the comparative test and apparent-completeness qualification; P006 and P007 identify the candidate routes and contrasted flagged cases.

signal_basis.value: Compare the candidate routes' predictions with documentary links, timing and missing traces in the other sampled orders, checking whether approval records connect to the order, precede placement and show appropriate authority.
signal_basis.scope: A proposed comparison within the existing sample, evaluated under the assumed occurrence of the described observations; no actual findings are asserted.

provenance.rationale: The cited spans specify the comparison group, predicted-versus-observed comparison, documentary checks and proposed status of the observations.
The bounded procedural claim is supported without an additional unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: Comparing route predictions with traces in the other sampled orders directly tests whether those routes explain apparently complete records. The claim recommends that test without asserting successful explanation, established compliance or population generalizability.
uncertainty: The comparison's outcome remains open; that does not undermine the warrant for performing this bounded test.
